skills.name: Free AEO Audit
skills.description: Instant Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) audit for any website. Returns a 0-100 score, grade A-F, and prioritized recommendations for AI visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview. Free, no signup required. Tuned for Norwegian B2B SaaS but works for any URL.

endpoints.description: MCP tool analyze_aeo({url}) returns the same audit

skills.name: AI Citation Measurement (Sitert-måling)
skills.description: Measures whether AI assistants cite a Norwegian brand in its own market, and names who gets cited instead. Five buying-intent questions, at least nine runs over several days, byte-identical prompts, written report with raw data by email. Pricing (two packages, ex. VAT): Sitert-måling 9 900 NOK one-time (invoice, 14-day terms, no meetings) and Synlig Lite 990 NOK one-time (FAQPage JSON-LD for one page, 1 business day). A measurement is a measurement — no ranking promise. Method and limits: https://synligdigital.no/metode

endpoints.description: Order form for Synlig Lite. The citation measurement is ordered by email to hei@synligdigital.no with subject 'Sitert-måling'.
